scenes.title:
Trust the work.
See the evidence.
scenes.text: Hermes moves fast. Kujo helps you check the work and explain what actually happened.

scenes.title: Install. Set up. Ask Hermes.
scenes.text: With Hermes and Kujo installed, install the plugin, accept the prompts, and run setup for your repository. Then start a new conversation.

scenes.title:
Give your agent
a clear path.
scenes.text: PackWrite organizes instructions into an execution pack, so your agent has a clear path. Here, all seven phases are present.

scenes.title:
Agree on what
done means.
scenes.text: Spec validates your task contract, so you can check the work against clear acceptance criteria.

scenes.title:
You decide
what runs.
scenes.text: You stay in control. In this free-model run, Hermes asks before Eval executes repository checks.

scenes.title:
Check the work.
See what passed.
scenes.text: Eval gives you repeatable checks. Here, the unit test passes and the implementation exists. You can inspect both results.

scenes.title:
Find the gaps
before release.
scenes.text: ShipCheck flags release-review gaps, so you know what needs attention before you ship. This repository still has warnings.

scenes.title:
Find your way
around the code.
scenes.text: Scout maps the repository so you can find your bearings. More tools cover context, workflows, and development, with their own prerequisites.

scenes.title:
Hand off evidence.
Keep the trust.
scenes.text: Receipts preserve the command, approval, and evidence hashes. The next developer can trace the run without reconstructing your session.
